patch_description:
This version combines a diverse unrestricted restart portfolio with batched smooth minimax optimization and final exact epigraph polishing.

The seed portfolio includes Gaussian configurations, staggered-ring arrangements, and perturbed icosahedral 12-point arrangements with two independently displaced additional points. These seeds avoid imposing antipodal symmetry while covering several useful contact-graph families. A vectorized population Adam continuation optimizes the smooth log-distance min/max surrogate, then elite descendants receive a sharper continuation. Finally, several leading candidates are rescaled to unit shortest squared distance and polished with SLSQP on the exact hard constraints `1 <= q_ij <= D`, minimizing diameter-squared `D`. The returned candidate is always selected by the evaluator’s exact squared-distance ratio.
